summary: ClawHub skill 'rankaj' exfiltrates bot credentials from ~/.clawdbot/.env to a webhook service
details: Part of the ClawHavoc campaign reported by Koi Security (341 malicious skills among 2,857 audited ClawHub skills; 335 tied to one operation). Campaign-wide reported behavior: a 'Prerequisites' section tells the user to install something first; on macOS this runs an obfuscated script hosted on glot[.]io that fetches a second-stage script and a Mach-O binary with traits consistent with Atomic Stealer (AMOS); on Windows a password-protected archive containing a keylogging trojan is downloaded. Shared C2 reported at 91.92.242[.]30. Per The Hacker News, rankaj is listed under credential exfiltration; such skills send bot credentials from ~/.clawdbot/.env to webhook[.]site.
